{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/sh

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly.
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from PBS:
#   -l nodes=1            -> -N 1
#   walltime=10:00:00     -> -t 10h
#
# NOTE: PBS -l mem=2gb not translated.
# Performance implication: without a memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed, affecting reliability/performance.
#
# NOTE: PBS -V not translated.
# Performance implication: usually none (Flux typically inherits the environment), but if your site sanitizes environments, missing exports could change runtime behavior.
#
# NOTE: PBS -W group_list=hpcstats not translated.
# Performance implication: may affect access/priority/accounting; without it, job may be rejected by site policy or behave differently.
#
# NOTE: PBS -o/-e to localhost:/... not translated.
# Performance implication: none; operational implication: stdout/stderr will follow Flux defaults unless configured at submission.

JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -t 10h --wrap "sh $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: PBS_ARRAYID is PBS-specific and not set under Flux.
  # Best-effort: use FLUX_TASK_RANK (0 by default) as an index.
  PBS_ARRAYID="${FLUX_TASK_RANK:-0}"

  # config_path must be set in the environment or replaced.
  config_path="${config_path:-$config_path}"

  flux run -n 1 /usr/local/bin/matlab-R2012b -r "addpath(genpath('/hpc/stats/users/dbp2112/Janelia/quagga')); roiFromPatch(${PBS_ARRAYID},'${config_path}');"
fi
"
}
